title: Emma's Fluffy Air Fryer Glazed Donuts
ingredients: Vanilla Glaze: 1.5 cups (180g) powdered icing sugar, 3 tbsp milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, plus melted butter for brushing
instructions: Whisk warm milk, sugar, melted butter, egg, and yeast together, then mix in flour and salt; knead for 5–6 minutes until a soft, pillowy dough forms.
Cover and let rise in a warm spot for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Roll the dough out to 1/2-inch thickness, cut out 8 donuts and donut holes, and let proof on parchment squares for 25 minutes until puffy.
Preheat Air Fryer to 350°F (175°C). Brush donuts lightly with melted butter, air-fry for 4–5 minutes until golden brown, and dip immediately while warm into the smooth vanilla powdered sugar glaze.
sourceTitle: Emma Fontanella · Air Fryer Glazed Donuts
